summary: No installer-side threat identified in tailwind-anim@1.2.4
details: tailwind-anim@1.2.4 is a small npm package with no observed installer-harm behavior. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no credential or environment scraping, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no silent-relay of caller data, and no persistence or backdoor mechanisms were identified in the package's contents.
